source: Chrome 153 headless + CDP against disposable QA worktree on allowed local origin
timing_note: Local FCP/load timings are diagnostic only and are not used as production performance claims.
fixes: Homepage shelves now mount progressively: 8 initial on <=760px, then IntersectionObserver batches.
All homepage product images remain lazy-loaded.
Mobile brand, theme toggle and survey close controls now expose >=44px hit areas.
Service Worker cache bumped to hunt-shell-pwa2.
JS/CSS/JSON/webmanifest changed from stale-while-revalidate to network-first.
Service Worker registration now uses updateViaCache=none.
Homepage asset query versions bumped so the performance patch cannot be hidden by the old PWA cache.

pwa_truth.root_cause: Old service worker used stale-while-revalidate for JS/CSS, so the first navigation after the patch could receive cached code.
